nodes.statement: Reported hottest-cell temperature at or above the 55 C reference trip threshold requests isolation and derating.
A reported pressure failure requests isolation and zero pump demand in one controller evaluation.
Selected supplier cooling design meets independently reviewed flow, hotspot and fault-detection limits.
A reported unavailable battery pump requests isolation and traction derating, with pump demand zero, in one controller evaluation.
Cooling isolation leads to a safe operating state with reviewed separation, passenger conditions and recovery.
Cooling connection installation records controlled supplier torque, calibrated tool and inspection before release.
